shortDescription: A modern overhaul of RimWorld's dev tools: a debug log that traces errors to the culprit mod and explains them (stack + log-prefix + Harmony patch-owner attribution, a shipped known-issue library plus a benign "no-concern" library, mod-shipped + opt-in community bug DBs, an optional Circinus corpus-prevalence bridge, About.xml incompat + proactive dependency/load-order scan, and a glossary), a global knowledge-base browser, an in-game bug/fix report composer, a suite-styled mod-settings page in parity with the Modules window, a 3-tab dev actions window and reskinned palette, plus impact scoring and updated-mod tracking.
body:
## Modern Dev Tools

A modern overhaul of RimWorld's developer tools (Modern Suite). Namespace `ModernDevTools`, assembly `ModernDevTools.dll`, packageId `astryl.ModernDevTools`. C# + Harmony. Open source (MIT). **Current release: v1.2 (`ModernDevToolsMod.Version`), Workshop id 3771602203.**

### Shared UI (`Palette`)
Dark suite chrome, sentence case, ASCII, cached Theme.Accent, flat gray scrollbars. `GameFont.Tiny` is banned suite-wide with one deliberate exception: the dev palette's category line (see Tool 3). Shipped icons in `Textures/UI/DevTools/` via `MdtTex`. `Palette.SearchField`, `Palette.ToggleRow`/`ToggleRowHeight`, `DrawCard`, `SectionHeader`, `DrawToggle`, `GrayButton`, `StateStrip`, `LabelFit`, `BeginScroll`.
- **Text-scaling rule:** never scale text with `GUI.matrix` inside a `Window` — labels render in screen space. Use the three built-in fonts and size rects from `Text.LineHeightOf(font)`.

### Tool 1: modern debug log (`Window_ModernLog`)
Redirects `UIRoot.CheckOpenLogWindow` + `DebugWindowsOpener.ToggleLogWindow`. Left list (culled) + right inspector. Inspector: impact banner (`ImpactAssessor`) → likely source → "What this means" (diagnoses sorted by Score) → module `DrawSection` hooks → report card → stack trace.
- **Auto-open suppression toggle (settings, off by default): `dontAutoOpenAtMainMenu`.**
- **Toolbar B (right→left):** Clear, Copy all, Modules, Update info, Knowledge base, search field.
- **Copy affordances:** toolbar `Copy all` + per-message `Copy message` / `Copy stack trace` / `Copy report`. Vanilla has *no* log-upload button (that's HugsLib's `LogPublisher`; deliberately not cloned — embedded token + dead git.io shortener). `Copy all` only serializes the in-memory list; a file-based "Copy full log" bundle is a considered-but-unbuilt follow-up.

### Impact scoring (`ImpactAssessor`) — location is NOT frequency
- **The rule:** `TickSignals`/`FrameSignals` only prove *where* an error happened; nearly everything runs under `TickManager.DoSingleTick`. **A performance claim requires recurrence (`msg.repeats`), never hot-path frames alone.**
- Thresholds: `RepeatingThreshold = 3`, `SpamThreshold = 10`; `hot = (tick||frame) && repeating`. Critical requires `spam || hot`; one-off error tops at High. Warnings mirror (Moderate needs `spam || hot`, else Low). Perf note only when `repeating`.
- **Curated override:** `ErrorDiagnosis.MaxImpact` (from `KnownIssueDef.maxImpact`) caps the level (`Critical=0 → Info=4`; default Critical = no-op). Capping drops the TPS/FPS note and sets `ImpactResult.Capped`.
- **"Known issue" badge = curated match only:** `ImpactResult.Known` reads `Diagnoses.Any(d => d.FromLibrary)`. `FromLibrary` set **only** by `Module_KnownIssues`, `Module_ModIssues`, `Module_CommunityBugs`.

### Knowledge-base content & factual-provenance convention — AUDITED 2026-08
**Factuality rule: every match string must be a verbatim engine string, verified against decompiled Verse/RimWorld source, with a `source file:line` provenance comment.** A full audit (2026-08, four-lens pass) verified or fixed **every** entry; ~12 phantom/mispunctuated patterns fixed. Trap classes documented in debugging lore: exact punctuation (`TryMakePreToilReservations()` has parens), keyed-translation indirection (mod-list warnings render Core Keyed values: "must be loaded before", NOT "should be"), runtime-native strings not in Assembly-CSharp (`wrapper dynamic-method` = Mono, `Could not load type` = .NET, IMGUI = Unity — marked as such, never fabricated), and messages that don't exist (a missing translation key logs NOTHING; `Translator.Translate` silently falls back).
Unbiased rule: shipped defs never name a third-party mod; `fix` text is always user-actionable. Current inventory:
- **`Defs/KnownIssueDefs.xml` — 44 always-on entries**, all with verbatim provenance comments. Sections: load-time mod metadata (ModMetaData.cs:155–219); exceptions; startup & init; def/XML data (audit fixes: `MDT_CrossRef` +"defs of this type loaded"; `MDT_DuplicateDef` → "adding duplicate"; `MDT_UnknownField` → "corresponds to a field in type"; `MDT_XmlError` +"could not load defs for mod", dropped "unknown field"; `MDT_DefInstantiate` rescoped to "could not instantiate" comp family; `MDT_MissingTranslation` rewritten — real strings Translator.cs:36/:76/:94 + DefInjectionPackage:506/:560); patches/load-order/save-load (`MDT_Incompatible` fixed to Core Keyed values); **self-healing vanilla fallbacks — 4 entries, all `ignorable` + `maxImpact=Low`:** `MDT_RaidArrivalFallback` (IncidentWorker_Raid:57), `MDT_RaidStrategyFallback` (:38 + RaidEnemy:99), `MDT_PawnGroupFallback` (PawnGroupKindWorker:54/:18), `MDT_WeatherFallback` (WeatherDecider:134); pawn AI/jobs (`MDT_Reservation` → "trymakepretoilreservations() returned false" **with parens**; `MDT_JobLoop`; `MDT_JobException`); `MDT_HarmonyConflict` **reworded per Harmony execution model** — a single mod's patch produces the same `wrapper dynamic-method` frames, so no "conflict" claim (that needs the patcher count from `Module_HarmonyPatches`, ≥2 foreign); common .NET exceptions; content/quests/UI (`MDT_GuiState` dropped Unity-native "begingroup").
- **`Defs/BenignLogDefs.xml` — 5 entries, all verified.**
- **`Data/community-bugs.json.gz` — 17 entries, audited** (reservation parens, settings LoadedModManager:542, pawn render PawnRenderer:425 + DynamicDrawManager:229, dropped "no definition for"; "getting types in assembly" verified GenTypes:125 + ModAssemblyHandler:61/:77). Workflow: gunzip → edit plain → `gzip -9` → delete plain. **Pending: sync the fixed entries to the live `ModernDevTools-KnownIssues` repo** (the opt-in fetch source still serves the old patterns).
- **Glossary — ~26 terms.** Harmony terms verified; `MDT_GlPrePostfixDef` notes prefix-skip as a conflict source.

### Benign "no concern" classification
`KnownIssueDef.benign` (in `Defs/BenignLogDefs.xml`). `HasBenignMatch` before the module loop (only `msg.type != Error`) → attribution suppressed, green badge, impact Info, report card hidden. Distinct from `maxImpact` (benign = normal output; maxImpact = real but mild fallback).

### Analysis modules ("What this means") + extensibility
`ErrorModuleDef`/`ErrorModule`/`ModernDevToolsAPI` + `ErrorContext`. Per module: `ContributeAttribution` then `Diagnose`, in `def.order`; diagnoses sorted by Score. 13 modules, defs in flat `Defs/ErrorModules.xml`: StackTrace, LogPrefix, MessageMentions, HarmonyPatches, VersionMismatch, KnownIssues, ModIssues, Community, CommunityBugs, AboutIncompat, DependencyCheck, CircinusCorpus, Glossary.
- **Harmony patch-owner attribution:** live-registry reverse map; conflict wording only at ≥2 foreign owners (Score 6.5), single-patcher wording at 4.5. Keyed strings semantics-verified. Heuristic — never `FromLibrary`.
- Index prewarm off-thread; Harmony index lazy; dependency scan mirrors `GetModWarnings`; Glossary order 900.

### Diagnosis Score scale (house rule)
Single digits: ModIssues 9+(n−i) > CommunityBugs 8+(n−i) > DependencyCheck 8–8.5 > AboutIncompat 7 > Community 6–7 > HarmonyPatches 4.5–6.5 > VersionMismatch 5 > **KnownIssues n−i (lone match = 1;** benign +1000). New context-only modules must score **< 1**.

### Circinus bridge (`Module_CircinusCorpus`, def `MDT_CircinusCorpus`, order 140)
Gated on `requiresPackageId astryl.Circinus`. Reflection-binds `Circinus.KnownIssues` (`Describe`, `ImplicatedMod`). One-shot probe; loud `WarningOnce` only on contract drift; throw nulls every binding. `Score = 0.5`, `Ignorable`, not `FromLibrary`. Attribution 2.0 (< WeightMessageName 2.5); fires only at ≥25/≥25 corpus runs. Verified in-game (run #132). Open item: `ImplicatedMod` not yet in Circinus's frozen-contract doc block (edit handed over for the Circinus scope).

### Settings surfaces — parity contract
`ModernDevToolsSettings` / mod-settings page (`SettingsPage.Draw`, canonical superset) / `Dialog_Modules` (quick subset; shares `SourceTag`/`CommunityStatus`). Rule: settings page ⊇ Modules window. `Documentation/UI-Parity.md`.

### Tool 4: global knowledge base (`Window_KnowledgeBase`)
8 categories, searchable, provenance-cited: Sources, Known issues, Benign log lines, Community bugs, Compatibility, Dependencies, Harmony patches (≥2 foreign = amber, cap 300), Glossary.

### Community data (opt-in, `CommunityData`)
Off by default; background fetch, cached, offline fallback. RimSort Community Rules + Use This Instead + our known-issues.json at `Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues`. Offline snapshot `Data/community-bugs.json.gz`.

### In-game reporting (`ReportBuilder`, `Dialog_Report`)
Server-less; destination: culprit's GitHub → Workshop → community Issue Form. FNV-1a `[#xxxxxxxx]`.

### Tool 2: dev actions window (`Window_ModernDevActions`, 3-tab)
Vanilla `DebugActionNode` graph + "Modern Dev Tools" test category. Searchable icon-grid spawn pickers; Esc steps up; BFS search; `OpenAt(node)`.

### Tool 3: dev palette (`Window_ModernDevPalette`)
Reskins `Dialog_DevPalette`; resolves pins fresh per frame. `DebugTree` PrettyPrefix/Leaf/Name; two-line rows; auto-fit width 220–640; browser-tab drag-to-reorder (own drag state; never `Event.Use()` on MouseUp; `_swallowClick`); `Patch_DebugActionNodeEnter` keeps submenus in-suite.

### Updated-mod tracking + update notes
`GameComponent_ModSnapshot` → `Dialog_ModChanges`. `Dialog_UpdateNotes` once per `ModernDevToolsMod.Version` (now **1.2**; `MDT_UpdateNotesBody` rewritten for 1.2: knowledge base, honest impact scores, fallback labeling, library audit, benign lines, palette drag/auto-fit, settings rebuild, optional Circinus).

### Experimental hardening
`WindowWatchdog` + `UiHardening`, two toggles, off by default.

### Testing / environment note
Silent crashes during testing traced to **ReShade** (`dxgi.dll`), NOT the mod.

### Localization
`Languages/English/Keyed/ModernDevTools.xml` (`MDT_*`): impact, settings, knowledge-base, glossary (26 pairs), Harmony module strings (semantics-verified), Circinus keys, update notes (1.2).

## Release / publishing state
**v1.2 prepped 2026-08:** version bumped, update notes rewritten, About.xml description accuracy-passed (40+ entries claim, knowledge base + glossary + no-concern + honest-impact additions — structure and Quality Commitment untouched), About/Preview.png kept (screenshot-backed, current), `Source/obj` cleaned (regenerates on build — re-clean before Workshop upload if rebuilt), XML validated, build green. Git: commit `98f6ca6` pushed to `Astryls/ModernDevTools`. **User actions remaining:** (1) upload the update in-game (Mods → Modern Dev Tools → Upload; item 3771602203); (2) push the fixed community-bugs entries to `Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues` (live fetch source still has pre-audit patterns).

## GitHub Backup
MIT. Mod repo: **https://github.com/Astryls/ModernDevTools** (PUBLIC). Community bug DB (CC0): **https://github.com/Astryls/ModernDevTools-KnownIssues** (PUBLIC). `Source/`, `Assemblies/*.dll`, `.modmixer/`, `Data/community-bugs.json.gz` tracked.
